 I. BACKGROUND
    The Energy Conservation Construction Code of New York State (ECCCNYS) became effective on December
    31, 2025. By State law, all local government energy codes, including New York City Energy Conservation Code
    (NYCECC), must be no less stringent than the ECCCNYS. The 2025 New York City Energy Conservation Code
    (2025 NYCECC) has been adopted in compliance with State Law; however, it will not be enforced until updated
    compliance software platforms are publicly available. The anticipated enforcement date of the 2025 NYCECC
    is March 30, 2026. The Department of Buildings will continue to enforce the 2020 NYCECC until such time. Any
    change to this date will be communicated by the Department by Service Update.
    This Bulletin clarifies the conditions under which the provisions of the 2025 New York City Energy Conservation
    Code (NYCECC) and 2025 NYC ASHRAE 90.1 apply as they pertain to application submissions.


 II. NEW PROJECTS
    If the application for construction document approval is submitted on or after March 30, 2026, then the
    application must comply with the 2025 NYCECC or 2025 NYC ASHRAE 90.1. If the application for construction
    approval is filed before March 30th, 2026, then it must comply with the 2020 NYCECC.
    For an application to be considered filed, the following requirements must be met:
    • the construction documents submitted meet the minimum requirements for completeness, as per 1RCNY
      5000-01 and the Department’s Project Guidelines
    • the application includes a complete energy analysis
    • the application thereafter is diligently pursued to completion.
    Jobs filed before March 30, 2026, with an incomplete energy analysis or with a pre-filing or incomplete status
    are considered incomplete application submissions and will have to comply with the 2025 NYCECC.


 III. PRIOR PROJECTS
    Complete energy submissions filed before March 30, 2026, must comply with the 2020 NYCECC.

     BIS projects with a BIS Job Status Code or ‘D’ and an Online Code ‘A/P’ prior to March 30, 2026, must
     comply with the 2020 NYCECC.
     Projects filed before March 30, 2026, that change their NYCECC or ASHRAE 90.1 compliance path from a
     prescriptive compliance path (e.g. Tabular Analysis, ResCheck or ComCheck) to a modeling compliance
     path (i.e., ERI, Energy Cost Budget Method or Appendix G) on or after March 30th, 2026; must comply with
     the 2025 NYCECC or 2025 NYC ASHRAE 90.1.


   IV. POST APPROVAL AMENDMENTS AND SUBSEQUENT APPLICATIONS FILED ON OR
       AFTER MARCH 30, 2026
     Post Approval Amendments to existing applications that do not include a material compliance change may
     comply with the 2020 NYCECC or the NYCECC applicable at the time those projects were filed.
     Post Approval Amendments to existing applications that undergo a material compliance change must comply
     with the 2025 NYCECC or 2025 NYC ASHRAE 90.1.
     Subsequent filings to existing complete applications must follow the same version of the NYCECC in effect
     as the original application as long as this does not represent a material compliance change.
